Quilchena is an MLS® sub-area of Vancouver. From November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 52 homes sold there: 19 houses, 25 condos and 8 townhomes. 25 condos sold in Quilchena with a median price of $930,000 (the middle half sold between $850,000 and $1,212,000), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 96.8% of the last list price; 4% sold above list.
Quilchena home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

25 condos sold in Quilchena with a median price of $930,000 (the middle half sold between $850,000 and $1,212,000), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 96.8% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $1,039 per square foot, a median year built of 2003 and a median strata fee of $593 a month. 19 houses sold in Quilchena with a median price of $3,550,000 (the middle half sold between $2,996,944 and $4,475,000), taking a median of 39 days to sell at 93.6% of the last list price; 11% sold above list. They had a median $982 per square foot, a median year built of 1965 and a median lot of 7,019 square feet.

items.t: VSB places Quilchena Elementary (5300 Maple Street) and Maple Grove Elementary in Kerrisdale.
Quilchena Park (about 7.7 hectares) is bounded by Valley Drive, 33rd Avenue, the Arbutus rail corridor and 30th Avenue.

The original golf club's clubhouse stood at 29th Avenue and East Boulevard; the Park Board says the park was created in the 1960s after the course closed and much of the land was developed for housing.
Low-density lots are in the City's R1-1 zone, which consolidated nine RS zones.

blocks.text: Quilchena: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: Quilchena Park has two ball diamonds, two soccer fields, a disc golf course, a field house, Hellenic Garden and a perimeter path.
A skateboard park is at 4590 Magnolia Crescent, at the park's northeast corner.
VSB names Kerrisdale Arena, Kerrisdale Library, Kerrisdale Pool and the Arbutus Greenway as resources near Maple Grove Elementary.

Quilchena Elementary, 5300 Maple Street, about 320 students, English and French Immersion tracks, next to Point Grey Secondary; VSB states an English catchment of roughly Larch to Granville Street and 33rd to 41st Avenue.
Maple Grove Elementary, 1924 West 45th Avenue, K-7 with a Montessori program, sharing grounds with Magee Secondary; no catchment stated.

faq.q: What did condos in Quilchena sell for?
faq.a: 25 condos sold in Quilchena from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, at a median price of $930,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Quilchena?
faq.a: Typical time on the market was 24 days. At the median, sale prices were 96.8% of list, and 4% of sales closed above list (November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).

faq.q: What price range do most condos in Quilchena sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 25 condos that sold in Quilchena went for between $850,000 and $1,212,000, around a median of $930,000.

faq.q: Do condos in Quilchena sell above asking price?
faq.a: 4% of the 25 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.8% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in Quilchena?
faq.a: Of the 25 sales, 25 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $593.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in Quilchena?
faq.a: The median year built was 2003 for the 25 condos sold in Quilchena.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in Quilchena usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Quilchena had 2 bedrooms, from the 25 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Vancouver?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
